articles.title: Russian strikes in Kyiv region kill 4 people, including a 3-year-old
articles.summary: Russian drone and ballistic missile attacks in Ukraine's Kyiv region reportedly killed a three-year-old boy, his grandparents, and another person in the capital, according to the Ukrainian President. These overnight strikes underscore the severe civilian casualties and ongoing humanitarian crisis stemming from persistent hostilities. The incident highlights the devastating impact of modern warfare on non-combatants.

articles.title: UK armed forces step up monitoring of increased Russian activity in UK waters
articles.summary: The Royal Navy deployed warships and helicopters for 21 days in July to monitor Russian activity in UK waters and the North Atlantic. articles.title: Russia denies it was behind bomb drone attack on German airport foiled by hero bus driver - as fears grow that Putin could launch new Nato assault

articles.title: Over 4,048 seafarers repatriated amid West Asia conflict: Shipping Minister
articles.summary: Union Shipping Minister Sarbananda Sonowal announced that over 4,048 Indian seafarers have been safely repatriated amidst the ongoing West Asia conflict. This repatriation drive, initiated under Prime Minister Narendra Modi's guidance, highlights India's commitment to ensuring the safety and well-being of its citizens abroad, especially during geopolitical tensions, and is a significant national effort.
